Definition: properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sleep, be asleep; 1a) (Qal) to sleep, go to sleep, be asleep; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to remain a long time, be stored up; 1b2) to be festering (of leprosy); 1c) (Piel) to cause to sleep, entice to sleep
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
